Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Just to be sure I read those correctly...

Relevant texts :

Justicar Retribution
Political Card - Worth 1 Vote. Called by any Camarilla vampire at +1
stealth. Successful referendum burns all vampires with a current bleed of 3
or more.

Guarded Rubrics
Unique equipment. Requires a Black Hand vampire. The vampire with his
equipment may bleed at +2 bleed as a (D) action that costs 1 blood. While
bearer is ready, Gehenna cards cost an additional pool to play.

The vamp with GR can bleed at 3 anytime, but I don't see him as having a
"current bleed" of 3, so I don't think he would burn under a Justicar
Retribution. Am I right ?

--
Orpheus
